criteria_adjudication.author_review_scope: Original case only; author did not read the generated reply or judge result.
criteria_adjudication.resolution: The branch was optional background for the requested review reply. The actual requirement to answer the full-suite status must remain mandatory. Original cases and judgments are retained; no rewrite was changed to satisfy the excessive checklist.
criteria_adjudication.limitation: One probe without checklist hints cannot by itself establish a causal effect; adjudication also relied on the original task and the case-author review.

execution.note: 29 CLI editing/judging calls plus one criteria-review task meet the 30-call editing/review ceiling. Initial case authoring is separate. Re-audits reuse the same six independent drafts. The seventh draft is a targeted probe on a calibration input; no retry or skill candidate.

limitations: Six synthetic source packets, three development and three holdout; one generation per case, no alternative skill candidate.
The same model family supplied generation and judging. There was no human author or professional editor review of the generated drafts.
Final grading followed an explicit evaluator correction after a questionable holdout verdict; initial verdicts and adjudication evidence remain visible.
Calibration is a small set of predefined checks, including a consumed draft in paired calibration, not an accuracy estimate or an unseen writing test.
No measured stylistic improvement, failure-rate reduction, review-time gain or comparison with an unassisted model.
Cases are consumed for future rounds. The original r5-holdout-02 checklist contains known excessive and weak requirements; review it against the source task before reuse.
No live repository investigation, file editing integration, publication behavior or other model family was tested in this text-only round.
